schema.description:
An assignment that specifies applicable parameter types to a type of Emission Activity. Parameter
assignments may be combined into Emission Activity Recording Templates.
Note: The Emission Activity may be characterized by Emission Activity Type (industry specific) or
Emission Activity Category (non-industry specific).
schema.title: Emission Activity Type Parameter Type Assignment

emission_activity_category_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Activity Category.

physical_quantity_type_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Physical Quantity Type of the Emission Activity Type Parameter Type Assignment.

emission_activity_parameter_recording_te.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Activity Parameter Recording Template.

emission_activity_type_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Activity Type.

facility_type_id.description: The Foreign Key of the optional Facility Type of the Emission Activity Type Parameter Type Assignment.

emission_parameter_assignment_id.description: The Primary Key assigned to the Emission Activity Type Parameter Type Assignment.

emission_parameter_type_id.description: DEPRECATED, replace by Physical Quantity Type ID. Assigns a reference parameter type to an emission argument
